narr: Scattered, slow-moving convection beneath a humid high pressure ridge produced isolated flash flooding.
ev: Significant flash flooding in and around the Dollywood theme park turned several of the park's walkways into streams, flooding several shops within the park. Barnard Narrows Road at Decatur Highway was closed by flooding to a two-foot depth.
